image_axes: x right, y down (px). Motion is toward the top of the image (decreasing y).

camera.view: looking straight down; no visible perspective (ground grid lines parallel, uniform spacing), so one px scale for the whole ground plane

frame_duplicates.note: frames 0 and 1 are identical: nothing moves between them; motion starts after frame 1

plane.desc: white twin-engine airliner (A320/737-like), nose pointing up, towed upward along the lead-in line of stand 01 (x~475)
plane.visible_frames: 0-71 (tail/wings below the bottom edge before frame 50; fully in frame from frame 50)
plane.ref_point: bbox centre (x mid of wingtips, y mid of nose-tail) = (474.25, 754.5) at frame 71; origin of the model is not visible, any point on this rigid, non-rotating body moves identically

tug.desc: small dark/black aircraft tug (pushback/towing tractor) with yellow-orange trim and two orange front prongs, in front of the plane (above it in image), connected to the nose gear by a white two-rail towbar

towbar.desc: two thin white parallel rails between tug rear and plane nose
towbar.length_px: tug rear (y1) to plane nose = ~87 px, constant (moves with tug & plane)

helicopter.desc: camouflage (tan/brown) military helicopter with 5-blade dark main rotor, parked on stand 02 (right), nose up

stand_01_marking.desc: left parking stand: rounded yellow-outlined rectangle with large yellow '01'

lead_in_lines.desc: faint pale vertical guide lines below each stand: x~475 (stand 01, plane path) and x~1450 (stand 02)

centre_stripe.desc: light vertical double stripe between the stands, x~940-985

ground_grid.desc: concrete slab grid; dark lines about every 25 px (fine) - usable only as a relative check

side_walls.desc: dark vertical bands at x~40-70 and x~1845-1880 (building edges)

shadows.desc: diagonal stripe shadows (structure out of view) and the plane/tug shadows falling up-left; shadows are not part of the objects

events.event: start; plane+tug at rest-looking position (frame 1 identical to frame 0)
last frame before motion; from frame 2 on plane and tug move up ~5.24 px/frame at constant rate (no visible acceleration)
